units.time_ms: ms, Arduino millis() at the report
units.Ta_C, Tb_C, setpoint_C, TEC_C, T1_C..T5_: degC, raw beta-equation values (no offsets); Ta_C, Tb_C and setpoint_C are nan in RAW
units.step: active run segment: schedule step, or for a live run 1 at START and +1 at every change of a setting in use; 0 idle
units.feedforward_pwm: OL command from the Module 4 steady-state curve; nan in P, PI and RAW
units.controller_pwm: raw P or PI command before the cooling multiplier and clamp; nan in OL and RAW
units.signed_pwm: applied PWM, + heat, - cool (RAW: U0 + U sin(phase), no multiplier)

placeholder: nan = does not apply in this mode, or channel unreadable
